(* REQ: LANG-741 LANG-742 LANG-743 LANG-744 *)
MODULE Greeter;

FROM InOut IMPORT WriteString, WriteLn, WriteInt;

(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
CONST
  Max = 10;
  Mask = 0FFH;

TYPE
  Point = RECORD x, y: INTEGER END;

VAR
  i: CARDINAL;
  done: BOOLEAN;

PROCEDURE Square(x: INTEGER): INTEGER;
BEGIN
  RETURN x * x
END Square;

BEGIN
  done := FALSE;
  FOR i := 1 TO Max DO
    IF (i MOD 2 = 0) AND NOT done THEN
      WriteString("Hello, "); WriteString('world'); WriteInt(Square(i), 4); WriteLn
    END
  END;
  INC(i); done := TRUE
END Greeter.
